title: Sprint planning probes a query-log finding with pack --root _self before naming it off the kb's domains
goal: kb-sprint plan, for a goal that rejects query-log findings as off the kb's domains, runs each finding's question once with python3 _tools/rag.py pack and with --root _self and names a finding off-domain only when neither leads with a line that answers it; a finding the _self docs answer becomes a rules miss with a tested question instead (SP-flkl5gom close: F-6f7e881cdca1 and F-071ee8797647 were planned as off-target from their wrong public eval expectation, the check passed on that reason, and the review found the _self docs answer the first, parked as ST-v3yearsk). The rule is a tested _self question.

run: import csv,subprocess,sys;rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if 'query-log finding' in r['question'] and 'kb-sprint:plan' in r['sets'].split(';')];q=rows[0]['question'] if rows else '';p=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self',q],capture_output=True,text=True) if q else None;s=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## start SP')[0].split('## plan')[1];ok=bool(rows) and p.returncode==0 and 'coverage: good' in p.stdout and 'query-log finding' in s;print('tested plan-set question packs good and plan step names the probe:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Checks are planned when a sprint commits it (a tested _self question that packs good from the plan rule). Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 12 of 13, "Planning rules 2: plan-time warnings and probes"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence. Premise: kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv has no row with 'query-log finding' in a kb-sprint:plan set and the plan step names no probe of a finding (the item's check). Run at plan 2026-10-10: exit 1, False on the base, so the premise reproduces. The row lands through land --wait-merge, since that file is code lane (_tools/kblane.py), not done --commit.
